item: Enyaq iV – 12 V battery not charging
notes: Section p221 requires the battery warning together with the accompanying red triangle. Do not continue, switch ignition off and obtain specialist help. A specific combination, not a universal meaning of either symbol alone.

item: Enyaq iV – 12 V battery or related-system fault
notes: P222: amber battery together with amber warning and a battery/secondary-system fault message. The image alone establishes neither cause nor a failed battery.

item: Enyaq iV – low 12 V battery charge
notes: P222: amber battery with amber warning and a weak/discharged12V battery message. Recharging follows this message and manual; not a substitute for a red charging fault or other STOP.

P219 describes the separate coolant-level/temperature message. Not the overheated-electrical-system combination on p201, for which the manual explicitly prohibits adding coolant. Full message and symbol combination are decisive.
Requires simultaneous amber electric-drive and ABS symbols plus regeneration message. Manual requests specialist help. Not assigned to ABS alone; exact reusable drive graphic not established.
Red drive with thermometer; stop, ignition off, do not add coolant, seek specialist help. Not the separate low-coolant message.
In this edition amber permits appropriately careful continued travel with specialist help; red requires stopping and ignition off. Not generalized to other symbols/editions.

item: 12 V battery – message requests inspection or replacement
notes: Enyaq DE11.2020 p222: amber battery together with amber warning triangle and a wear/replacement message. Not the same interpretation as a low-charge or other-fault message.
